channel.title: Kumar Harsh: Writing
channel.description: Notes by freelance AI engineer Kumar Harsh on building AI systems that stay up: WhatsApp agents, LLM failover, RAG and how long an AI build takes.

item.title: How to build a WhatsApp AI assistant on Cloudflare Workers
item.description: The architecture behind Honey, a WhatsApp AI assistant on Cloudflare Workers and D1 that runs for ₹0 a month: failover cascade, memory and cron routines.

item.title: LLM provider failover: how to keep an AI app answering when a model API fails
item.description: How to design LLM failover: fallback cascades, timeouts, retry budgets, circuit breakers and chaos testing, with a TypeScript sketch.

item.title: How long does it take to build an AI agent?
item.description: Typical timelines for AI agents, RAG systems, AI MVPs and reliability work, and the factors that make a build shorter or longer.
